summary: Avricore Health Inc., a TSXV-listed foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K covering August 2026 developments. The filing includes a news release and material change report on a multi-year collaboration agreement between its wholly-owned subsidiary HealthTab Ltd and Abbott to distribute Abbott's Afinion 2 Analyzer for HbA1c and lipid testing in NHS-linked UK pharmacies. It also furnished interim financial statements, interim MD&A, CFO and CEO certifications, and an option grant release. No special-situation transaction, no definitive agreement regarding the registrant's securities, and no terms were stated.
